requirements.requirement: The system must define a sponsor_type field as an enum with allowed values NIH, Industry, Academic, and Other.
The system must define a credibility_score field as a float constrained between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.
The system must define an explanation field as a non-empty string describing the sponsor credibility assessment.
The system must ensure the schema is implemented as a Pydantic model compatible with existing clinical_trials_models.py structures.
The system must accept sponsor metadata inputs including lead_sponsor and collaborators with agency_class fields from clinical_trials_service outputs.
The system must map agency_class values from ClinicalTrials.gov to one of the defined sponsor_type enum values.
The system must serialize the sponsor credibility schema into JSON without loss of precision for credibility_score.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with Evaluate Care facade response models without requiring breaking changes.
The system must validate that credibility_score is present whenever sponsor_type is present.
The system must generate a deterministic schema structure such that identical inputs produce identical schema outputs.
The system must default sponsor_type to Other when agency_class is missing or unrecognized.
The system must allow explanation to reference both lead_sponsor and collaborators when present.
The system must reject schema instantiation if credibility_score is outside the 0.0 to 1.0 range.
The system must handle null or missing sponsor metadata inputs without raising unhandled exceptions.
The system must produce a valid schema object even when only partial sponsor data (e.g., only lead_sponsor) is available.
